reviews.body:
Thanks @pcbeingused333, nice find! We checked it against OpenRouter's Responses API with one request that differs only in `tool_choice`: the nested `{ type: 'function', function: { name } }` that `main` sent gets a 400 (`invalid_prompt`), and the flat `{ type: 'function', name }` from this PR succeeds and the model calls the tool.

We pushed a merge of `main` to resolve the CHANGELOG conflict. Your entry had landed in the 0.6.1 section, so we moved it under `[Unreleased]` and added a thanks line. Approving and merging. Thanks again!
